QuestInfo.name: Betray and You'll Pay
QuestInfo.1: #p2151001# hinted that he #bhas regrets over not trusting his allies in the past#k. He suggests visiting  #b#p2152000##k at the center of #b#m310000000##k.
QuestInfo.2: #bBrighton#k wants you to talk to Headmaster #b#p2152000##k.\r\nWill he trust you?

0.0: I'm #b#p2151001##k, the Battle Mage instructor for the Resistance. I must thank you for rescuing #p2151003#, but don't think you've earned my trust yet.
0.1: The nature of my work is too dangerous to trust with someone I've just met. The Black Wings are smart enough to make it look like they're helping us...
0.2: However, #bI'd rather not distrust my allies#k. I've made that mistake before.
0.3: I would feel better if you visited the #bHeadmaster#k. I want to know what he thinks about you.

yes.0: The #bHeadmaster#k hangs around the town center. I'd trust that man's judgment if he told me to jump into a volcano. If he gives you the okay, so will I.

no.0: No? You don't trust us either?

1.0: A glorious day to you. Are you a new student?

yes.0: Oh, the android! I've been told about you.

npc.0: You haven't found the #bHeadmaster#k? His name is #bFerdi#k. He's got a tall hat and a cane, stands around in town.
